commands.command:
PGCONF=/etc/postgresql/16/main/postgresql.conf
sed -i "s/^#listen_addresses.*/listen_addresses = '*'/" $PGCONF
sed -i "s/^#wal_level.*/wal_level = replica/" $PGCONF
sed -i "s/^#max_wal_senders.*/max_wal_senders = 10/" $PGCONF
sed -i "s/^#max_replication_slots.*/max_replication_slots = 10/" $PGCONF
sed -i "s/^#hot_standby.*/hot_standby = on/" $PGCONF
grep -E "^(listen_addresses|wal_level|max_wal_senders|max_replication_slots|hot_standby)" $PGCONF
commands.stdout:
listen_addresses = '*'
wal_level = replica
max_wal_senders = 10
max_replication_slots = 10
hot_standby = on
hot_standby = on

commands.command:
REPL_PW=$(openssl rand -base64 24)
echo "$REPL_PW" > /tmp/repl_pw.txt
chmod 600 /tmp/repl_pw.txt
sudo -u postgres psql -c "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='replicator'" | grep -q 1 || true
sudo -u postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "DO \$\$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='replicator') THEN CREATE ROLE replicator WITH REPLICATION LOGIN PASSWORD '$REPL_PW'; ELSE ALTER ROLE replicator WITH PASSWORD '$REPL_PW'; END IF; END \$\$;"
echo done

HBA=/etc/postgresql/16/main/pg_hba.conf
cat >> $HBA <<'EOF'
host    replication     replicator      10.100.151.11/32        scram-sha-256
host    replication     replicator      10.100.151.12/32        scram-sha-256
EOF
tail -5 $HBA
systemctl restart postgresql
sleep 2
systemctl is-active postgresql
ss -tlnp | grep 5432
